note: shipped vs staged geometry. Nothing ships until this is reviewed.
staged_from: Overture 2026-07-22.0 footprints + Open Buildings 2.5D p65 heights

sim_delta_K.note: eqMean at canonical forcing, flat measured means, so the only difference is the built raster. Published bands: +/-4.5 K peak, +/-3.0 K night.

accuracy_rerun.measure_accuracy: model-accuracy.json byte-identical after re-run. The calibration's built fraction comes from ESA WorldCover (landcover-fractions.json), not building footprints, so the published RMSE bands are structurally geometry-independent -- proven by diff, not assumed. Daytime RMSE shift is exactly zero, against the spec's +/-0.49 K hard stop.
accuracy_rerun.direction_check: All six ward x phase sim means moved TOWARD the observed LST: day errors +9.50/+9.42/+7.52 -> +9.13/+8.74/+7.39 K, night +5.15/+5.12/+4.56 -> +4.96/+4.78/+4.49 K. CAVEATS: the observed values are ward-invariant regional figures, so this is movement toward the observed LEVEL, not per-ward pattern validation; the large absolute day offsets are the documented canonical-forcing vs mean-overpass mismatch. The DELTA is the signal and it points the right way in every cell.
accuracy_rerun.height_floor: ~12 % of Overture footprints returned a zonal statistic BELOW Google's published 2.5 m minimum -- plenty of pixels, near-zero values, i.e. OSM features Google's ML never detected. Clamped to the floor and counted as fill, which brings the fill rate to 12-13 % against the shipped 4-11 %. Caught by the Task 6 guard test, not by inspection.

shipped.after_photo: validate-geometry.py re-run against public/: 3,527 ours vs 3,530 Overture in the Ballygunge window, and 0 buildings (0.0 %) more than 20 m from anything we hold -- down from 426 (12.1 %). The gap that started this work is closed.
shipped.rode_along: build-dcurs-inputs.py was BROKEN before this change and had to be fixed to ship: it converted view_delta to float before checking status, and 130 of 179 ecostress-suhii.csv rows are QC-skipped scenes with no measurement and so no view_delta. Fixing the crash also moved two OBSERVED values that had been stale since the census rows were added: lstDayC 30.14 -> 30.72 C and ruralBaseC 29.96 -> 30.96 C. These are NOT consequences of the geometry change and were not gated by this plan. The new values use the full current scene set with correct QC filtering, so they are the more defensible pair -- but they deserve their own review, and this note exists so that review is not forgotten.
